# The register of complaints about FerroEHR, kept by its manufacturer,
# Cadasto B.V. (Regulation (EU) 2025/327 Art 30(1)(o)). One row per
# complaint, whatever the channel it came through, appended and never
# rewritten; a row is closed by filling its last two columns.
# No row names the person who complained or carries patient data. The
# correspondence stays with the manufacturer, outside the repository. A
# vulnerability is entered once its advisory is published.
# Columns:
#   id              C-<year>-<number>, in the order the complaints arrived
#   received        the date the manufacturer received it, YYYY-MM-DD
#   channel         email, issue or advisory
#   versions        the FerroEHR versions it concerns
#   summary         what was reported, in one sentence
#   classification  complaint, non-conformity, serious-incident or exploited-vulnerability
#   record          the tracker issue or advisory that carries the work
#   outcome         what was done, in one sentence, once closed
#   closed          the date it was closed, YYYY-MM-DD, once closed
